chunks: The Shaykh, may Allah the Exalted support him, informed me from Abu al-Qasim Ja'far ibn Muhammad, from his father, from Sa'd ibn 'Abd Allah, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from al-Husayn, from Fadalah ibn Ayyub and Safwan ibn Yahya, from al-'Ala' ibn Razin, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from one of the two, peace be upon them, who said:
I asked him about a man afflicted with sores that keep bleeding continuously: how should he perform salat (prayer)? He said: “He performs salat (prayer) even if the blood is flowing.”

key_terms.الدِّمَاءُ: bloods; here, blood flowing from wounds
key_terms.الْقُرُوحُ: sores or wounds afflicting the body

ai.seo_question: How does a person with continuously bleeding sores perform salat (prayer)?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a person whose sores continuously bleed. It indicates that ongoing bleeding from such wounds does not prevent him from performing salat (prayer), even when the blood continues to flow.
